notes.title: Dreams of the Void 0.0.2 Update
notes.content:
Howdy! Today, we've released update 0.0.2 for Dreams of the Void! The main change is the new aspect ratio, allowing more things to be shown in-game. 

Before this update:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827198/35bb1bb74bf53f1eea9b3c59715d78968941009b.png[/img]

After this update:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827198/d31beb344d2454b9382b870f9a9510ec6894e8d6.png[/img]

In addition, a new feature has been added which allows you to hear May's thoughts on certain things.

It's [b]heavily recommended[/b] to start a new save file for this update.

Below are the full patch notes for this update!

[h3]Major changes[/h3]
[list]
	[*] Changed the game's resolution from 1:1 to 4:3.
	[*] Revamped maps to fit the new resolution and detailed them more.
	[*] Added the "Ponder" mechanic. This can be accessed from the pause menu. After certain events or upon entering certain areas, May might talk out loud to herself about what's on her mind.
	[*] Altered textbox noises to slightly change pitch at random. This will make constant navigation through text less audibly annoying.
	[*] Added four new maps to the left of the Lighthouse to explore.
[/list]

[h3]Minor changes[/h3]
[list]
	[*] Fixed May's walking animation not being synced to May's speed.
	[*] Added speed changes in multiple areas.
        [*] Added instructions to delete your save file on the title screen.
	[*] The ending of the prologue has been altered somewhat. Minor text changes have been made to some other visual changes to enhance the feeling.
	[*] Fixed some rough music loops.
	[*] Added new music to the title screen after completing the prologue.
[/list]

notes.title: Dreams of the Void 0.0.1 Update
notes.content:
Hello! Today, we've released update 0.0.1 for Dreams of the Void! It's a very minor update, but polishes what's in the game currently through bug fixes and aesthetical changes.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Updated lighthouse estate maps and the entrance and exit of the cave.
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed layer issues on the lighthouse estate.
[*] Fixed issue where May would rapidly change her direction when walking into a corner.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support of DotV and we hope you have a good day!
